settings.about_detail: A native WhatsApp client built with Rust, egui, and whatsapp-rust.
settings.audio_note: Each audio bubble carries its own speed chip: 1x, 1.5x or 2x. Changing it takes effect straight away, from where the clip already is.
settings.auto_download_detail: Download pictures, videos, voice messages, and documents up to 64 MB when they enter view. When off, click a file to download it.
settings.auto_update_detail: Download and verify new releases in the background. You choose when to restart. Native packages and Flatpak update through their package manager.
settings.check_updates_detail: Ask GitHub once a day whether a newer Vespera release exists. The request identifies only Vespera and its version.
settings.enter_sends_detail: When off, Enter adds a line and Ctrl+Enter sends.
settings.keep_running: Keep running when the window closes
settings.keep_running_detail: Keep Vespera linked in the system tray. Quit from the tray menu or with Ctrl+Q.
settings.language_detail: The whole catalog comes in English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish and Simplified Chinese. In Chinese, message dates and status texts stay in English.
settings.names_contacts_detail: Prefer saved contact names. When off, prefer public WhatsApp profile names. This applies throughout the app.
settings.notify_detail: Show desktop notifications when the window is hidden, in the background, or showing another chat. Muted chats do not notify you.
settings.play_next_detail: When a voice message or audio clip ends, continue with the next one in the same chat.
settings.receipts_off_detail: Read receipts are disabled for your WhatsApp account. Direct chats will not send them. When this switch is on, groups still do. Read state syncs between your devices either way.
settings.receipts_on_detail: Let people see when you read messages or play voice messages. Your WhatsApp privacy setting still applies. Read state syncs between your devices either way.
settings.save_contacts: Save contacts to the phone's address book
settings.save_contacts_detail: Also add contacts saved here to your phone's address book. When off, they remain WhatsApp contacts. Names sync to linked devices either way.
settings.sender_pictures: Show sender pictures in every chat
settings.sender_pictures_detail: WhatsApp shows them in groups only.
settings.theme_follow_omarchy: Follow system uses your Omarchy colours.
settings.theme_follow_system: Follow system uses your desktop's light or dark appearance.
settings.title: Settings
settings.update_channel_detail: Stable is the default. Testing also offers release candidates, which may be unfinished. A newer finished release always wins on either channel.
settings.zoom_hint: You can also use Ctrl+plus and Ctrl+minus.
toast.frequent_forward: Frequently forwarded messages go to one chat at a time
toast.group_left: You left the group. The conversation is archived.
toast.no_forward: None of these chats can receive forwards
toast.only_groups_renamed: Only groups can be renamed here
toast.video_unplayable: This video cannot be played here
viewer.copy_picture: Copy the picture to the clipboard
